answer.summary: Execution begins in src/main.py (as stated in README.md). main.py reads config/app.json via Path("config/app.json").read_text(), parses it with json.loads, and extracts the "audience" field (value "traveler"). It then calls greeting(audience) imported from src/greeting.py, which formats and returns the string f"Welcome, {audience}.". Finally, main.py wraps that return value in print(...), which writes the resulting line "Welcome, traveler." to stdout. The four files collectively establish: README.md documents the entry point and config location; config/app.json supplies the audience value; src/greeting.py defines the greeting template; src/main.py orchestrates the read-parse-call-print pipeline that delivers the configured audience to stdout.
